name: Working
description: Working is an American situation comedy that aired on NBC from 1997 to 1999. The series was created and executive produced by Michael Davidoff and Bill Rosenthal.

videos.title: Pilot
videos.overview: Matthew Peyser starts his new job, only to learn that the office is filled with people that do nothing â€“ and he gets promoted because his portfolio is switched with another workers'.

videos.title: Close Quarters
videos.overview: Matt catches the ""close-quarters syndrome"" and starts dating a daffy co-worker who's really not his type.

videos.title: Rumoring
videos.overview: To up his value to the company, Matt starts a rumor that he's been offered a better job with another company, but his plan backfires.

videos.title: Quick Out Of The Gate
videos.overview: Matt's drive to become a valuable employee earns him a reprimand for making everyone else look bad.  Meanwhile, Abby and Hal fight over the gorgeous latin copy guy.

videos.title: Sexual Harassment
videos.overview: A sexual harassment seminar transforms the staff into sexless zombies, putting a crimp into Matt's plans to date a new colleague.

videos.title: Lost Weekend
videos.overview: When Matt's father comes to spend a weekend with him, Tim makes them go all the weekend making Matt decide between working and spending the weekend with his father.

videos.title: Creative Matt
videos.overview: The office is invited to a party at Tim's house, and the bored staff convince a drunken Tim that Matt and the guy that he came to the party with are a gay couple.  Tim uses this information to his own advantage by setting up Matt with his boss's son.

videos.title: Top O' The World Ma
videos.overview: When one of Matt's decisions costs the company big bucks, all of his decisions tends to disaster. Meanwhile, Delaney tries to pick up a girl at work.

videos.title: Medieval Christmas
videos.overview: Hal's chauvinistic boss submits a sexy photo of her for the company's pinup calendar.

videos.title: The Breakfast
videos.overview: A member of Senior Management invites Matt to breakfast â€“ and then uses everything Matt says to form a case against Tim.  Meanwhile, Evelyn replaces Jimmy with an ape and convinces Abbey that her job is in jeopardy.

videos.title: Enemies: A Love Story
videos.overview: When Tim's wife leaves him, Matt becomes the victim â€“ Tim wants a buddy to talk to and Matt is the only one who can't come up with an airtight excuse not to hang out with him.

videos.title: Sam I Am
videos.overview: Matt goes out on a limb to help an old college buddy land a job, and soon comes to regret it when he won't show up.

videos.title: Boys Club
videos.overview: Deale casts for the new worker, with the Help of Matt. But he soons decides for one particular, chauvinist man. Until this new ""guy"" transforms into a woman. Tim fires her and then hires Matt dressed as a woman, so she stays with them, at least until the end of the season.

videos.title: Hatchet Man
videos.overview: Matt is challenged to prove he has the right stuff by firing an inept temp.

videos.title: Mum's The Word
videos.overview: Matt ends up babysitting a coworker's little terrors to protect her from Deale's vindictiveness.

videos.title: As Bad As It Gets
videos.overview: Matt puts a little danger in his life when he picks up an edgy beauty in a bar, only to learn that she is Tim's daughter, and that she's too much for him.

videos.title: Labor Pains
videos.overview: Tired of being taken advantage of, the staff, with Matt as their leader, goes on strike.

videos.title: The Gold Digger
videos.overview: A co-worker shows interest in Matt after he's enrolled in a management-trainee program.

videos.title: Equality
videos.overview: Matt helps a career woman shatter the company's glass ceiling, but the ""Old Boy Network"" of execs triples her workload in hopes that she'll crack under the pressure.

videos.title: The Lying Game
videos.overview: Perfectly honest Matt has to ""massage the truth"" when Abby asks why he won't date her.

videos.title: Due Process
videos.overview: Matt tries to push a proposal that the company initiate a four-day work week, but runs into some serious bureaucratic stonewalling.

videos.title: The Brown Noser
videos.overview: Tim tires of being a ""money-grubbing, care-only-for-myself phony"" and quits his job.

videos.title: Home-O-Apathy
videos.overview: On a trip to his old home town, Matt tries to make like a big man by making a big promise he can't possibly keep.

videos.title: The Closer
videos.overview: Matt is shocked to learn that Tim set him up to sleep with a client in order to land an account.

videos.title: Armageddon Outta Here
videos.overview: Matt forgoes research and follows his instincts for his latest project. But his plan brings a company satellite hurtling toward the building.

videos.title: Performance Review
videos.overview: Matt's honest self-evaluation inspires Tim to have Matt write them for fellow staffers as well.

videos.title: Good Val Hunting
videos.overview: Val gets promoted after solving a complex math equation that's baffled company accountants.

videos.title: Networking
videos.overview: Matt literally pushes corporate climber Liz over the edge at an executives' mountain retreat.

videos.title: A Boy, A Girl, And His Bird
videos.overview: No Synopsis Available. Please Contribute One If You Have Seen The Episode. Thank You.

videos.title: The Consultant
videos.overview: Management brings in a consultant who's going to turn the team into ""a lean, mean white-collar machine.""

videos.title: Greenery
videos.overview: Corporate golden boy Matt literally turns green with envy when his college rival becomes the youngest vice president in the company's history. Also, Abby tries to shake her lily-white image by stealing something big from Upton/Webber.

videos.title: The Christmas Party
videos.overview: Matt defies the edict about ""no secretaries"" at the company Christmas party by inviting Val as his guest.

videos.title: Romeo and Julie
videos.overview: In a spoof of Romeo and Juliet, Matt falls for a woman who works for Tim's archenemy in the company.

videos.title: The Retreat
videos.overview: Matt plans a retreat to a resort where employees can bare their souls, but when they arrive, they find patrons baring something else: their bodies. So to get his group focused, Matt decides to get naked.

videos.title: The Prodigy
videos.overview: Matt is feeling mighty old after the firm hires a younger gun to provide the firm with Gen X insights; Delaney, in a shallow attempt to brown-nose, agrees to help the boss's daughter win a Sunflower Girl Cookie contest.

videos.title: Manifesto Destiny
videos.overview: Matt writes a position paper and realizes that it's very similar to Marx's ""Das Kapital"" after it has been distributed to the entire company. This paper makes him get fired.

videos.title: The Other Executive
videos.overview: Tim gets jealous when Matt befriends another executive.

videos.title: She Loves Me, Yeah, Yeah, Yeah
videos.overview: Tim's daughter returns to Upton/Webber and becomes the ""Yoko Ono"" of the gang by clouding Matt's ability to make good decisions.

videos.title: Sliding Doors
videos.overview: What if Matt would have talked to the girl of his dreams?, maybe he could have gotten married... maybe the series would have had a happy ending, anyway... this episode was the last, and it ends with marriage... or not?
